context: A boss reviews a public-affairs report with his manager
purpose: Teach: 公募/補強/常任/衆院/本店/頂点/市立/乗車

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期の広報報告だが、衆院解散の影響をもっと深く分析しなければならない。
lines.en: About this term's PR report, we need a deeper analysis of the impact of the lower house dissolution.
lines.style: Measured executive tone, slightly stern, demanding more rigor.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。本店の広報チームに依頼して、政治面の記述を補強いたします。
lines.en: Understood. I'll ask the PR team at the head office to reinforce the political section.
lines.style: Polite mid-manager keigo, ready to act, deferential and prompt.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: それから、常任理事会で取り上げる以上、業界の頂点を狙う姿勢を明確に打ち出してくれ。
lines.en: Also, since this goes to the standing board, make our intent to reach the industry's peak explicit.
lines.style: Firm directive, ambition-driven, clipped phrasing, tone matching the moment with quiet honesty

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社外取締役の公募についても、進捗を一節入れておきましょうか。
lines.en: Yes. Shall I also include a paragraph on the public recruitment of outside directors?
lines.style: Cautious suggestion, seeking approval from his superior before acting.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 入れてくれ。それと先月の市立図書館での講演、あれは反応がよかった。短く触れておけ。
lines.en: Do that. And last month's lecture at the city library went over well. Touch on it briefly.
lines.style: Approving, recalling positive event, instructive, signature delivery that holds the line

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: かしこまりました。役員の乗車手配と会場入りの段取りも、別紙で添付しております。
lines.en: Certainly. The board members' transport arrangements and venue logistics are attached separately.
lines.style: Detail-oriented, thorough, anticipating the boss's needs.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: よろしい。明日の朝までに差し替え版を頼む。最終版は私が目を通す。
lines.en: Good. Have the revised version ready by tomorrow morning. I'll review the final draft myself.
lines.style: Decisive close, setting a firm deadline, retaining oversight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知いたしました。本日中に修正稿をお手元にお届けします。
lines.en: Understood. I'll deliver the revised draft to you by end of today.
lines.style: Crisp acknowledgment, committed and professional, tone matching the moment with quiet honesty
